rules.v: The general labor statute applies in full
rules.vi: UU ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku penuh
rules.n: The Employment Act applies in full to manual workers whatever their wage (First Schedule para 1, as substituted from 1 Jan 2023), including in agricultural undertakings. Estate workers paid by the day are guaranteed work on at least 24 days a month (s. 16). Act 446 sets housing and amenity standards for estates over 20 ha. Peninsular only; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.
rules.s: Employment Act 1955 ss. 2, 60K (Act A1651, 2022); Sabah Labour Ordinance (Cap. 67) · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

rules.v: The national statutory minimum wage applies
rules.vi: Upah minimum nasional berlaku
rules.n: The national minimum wage (RM1,700 a month from 1 Feb 2025; from 1 Aug 2025 for employers with fewer than five workers) applies with no exclusion for agriculture or for foreign workers. Piece-rate and tonnage workers must also receive at least RM1,700.
rules.s: National Wages Consultative Council Act 2011 (Act 732); Minimum Wages Order 2024 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputp/2541500/PUA%20376.pdf

rules.v: Statutory limits on hours apply
rules.vi: Batas jam kerja menurut undang-undang berlaku
rules.n: Limits of 8 hours a day and 45 a week (lowered from 48 by Act A1651) apply, with no exclusion for agriculture. The Director General may allow longer hours on application (s. 60A(1A)), and the Minister may exempt by order (s. 2B).
rules.s: Employment Act 1955 s. 60A (as amended 2022) · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

rules.v: Cannot change without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Tidak dapat pindah tanpa persetujuan majikan
rules.n: Each employer needs the Director General's prior approval to employ a foreign employee (Employment Act s. 60K), and must report when the worker leaves, absconding included (s. 60KA). A pass stops being valid once its conditions are breached (Immigration Act s. 55B(2)). The rule tying the Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) to one employer, and any transfer procedure, sit in the Immigration Regulations 1963 and in…
rules.s: Immigration Act 1959/63; Immigration Regulations 1963; Immigration Department guidance · official guidance: https://www.imi.gov.my/index.php/perkhidmatan-utama/pekerja-asing-2/

rules.v: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
rules.vi: Boleh bergabung tetapi dibatasi hukum, atau status tinggal membuat keanggotaan nyaris teoretis
rules.n: Non-citizens may join a union but may not be, or act as, members of a union executive (s. 28(1)(a)) or be employed by a union (s. 29(2)(a)). LOM lists a 12 Jan 2024 instrument for this Act that could not be opened.
rules.s: Trade Unions Act 1959 (Act 262), as amended 2024 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/16547_BI/001%20-%20Act%20262.pdf

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
rules.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
rules.n: Agencies may charge a non-citizen employee no more than one month's basic wage as a placement fee; if the employer pays, nothing may be taken from the worker (s. 14B(3)). Overcharging is an offence (s. 28). Fees charged in sending states are outside the Act.
rules.s: Private Employment Agencies Act 1981 (Act 246), as amended 2017; National Action Plan on Forced Labour 2021–2025 · official text:…

rules.v: Enrolled in the national labor or health insurance schemes
rules.vi: Terdaftar dalam skema jaminan ketenagakerjaan atau kesehatan nasional
rules.n: Covered by SOCSO as employees in an industry. The Act excludes only foreign workers without a valid pass (First Schedule para (12A)). The date foreign workers were brought in (reported as 2019) and the schemes that apply were not confirmed from the texts read. Act A1788 (2026, not yet in force) adds non-employment injury cover, which a foreign worker loses for misusing a pass.
rules.s: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 (Act 4); PERKESO, foreign workers scheme · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3226981_BI/Act%204%20(Online%202026).pdf

rules.v: Only general channels, or channels hard to reach from the workplace (for example at sea)
rules.vi: Hanya saluran umum, atau saluran yang sulit dijangkau dari tempat kerja (misalnya di laut)
rules.n: General Department of Labour offices and an online complaint system; plantations are often remote, and complaints require the worker's pass to be valid.

rules.fi: Jalur ke izin tinggal jangka panjang
rules.v: No route: fixed maximum stay, or time does not count
rules.vi: Tidak ada jalur: masa tinggal maksimum tetap, atau masa tinggal tidak dihitung
rules.n: No route was found in the texts read. Permanent residence (Entry Permit, s. 10) is at the Director General's discretion; maximum stay rules for foreign workers sit in policy and regulations not readable on the trusted sites.
rules.s: Immigration Act 1959/63; Ministry of Home Affairs policy · official guidance: https://www.imi.gov.my/index.php/perkhidmatan-utama/pekerja-asing-2/

rules.v: Barred
rules.vi: Dilarang
rules.n: Reported to be barred: Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) holders may not bring dependants. This could not be confirmed from any text on LOM.
rules.s: Immigration Department, conditions of the PLKS · official guidance: https://www.imi.gov.my/index.php/perkhidmatan-utama/pekerja-asing-2/

rules.v: A labor statute applies with exclusions, or a sector-specific labor statute applies
rules.vi: UU ketenagakerjaan berlaku dengan pengecualian, atau berlaku UU ketenagakerjaan sektoral
rules.n: The Employment Act covers domestic employees ('domestic servant' until Act A1651, in force 1 Jan 2023), but the First Schedule disapplies ss. 12, 14, 16, 22, 58A, 60, 60A–60F, 60FA, 60I, 61 and 64 and Parts IX (maternity) and XIIA (termination benefits). Part XI allows termination on 14 days' notice. Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.
rules.s: Employment Act 1955 First Schedule para. 2; Act A1651 (2022) · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

rules.v: No wage floor
rules.vi: Tidak ada batas upah
rules.n: The Minimum Wages Order 2024 (RM1,700 a month) does not apply to domestic servants. No other legal wage floor was found; pay floors set in bilateral arrangements with sending states are not in Malaysian law. The Order still says 'domestic servant', although the Act has said 'domestic employee' since 2023.
rules.s: Minimum Wages Order 2024; Malaysia–Indonesia MOU on domestic workers, 1 April 2022 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputp/2541500/PUA%20376.pdf

rules.v: Only minimum rest periods apply, or limits apply with sector exclusions
rules.vi: Hanya waktu istirahat minimum, atau batas berlaku dengan pengecualian sektor
rules.n: Since 1 Jan 2023 the weekly rest day (s. 59) applies, as Part XII is no longer excluded as a whole. Hours limits (s. 60A), pay for rest-day work (s. 60), holidays, annual leave and sick leave (ss. 60D–60F) remain excluded. Before 2023 all of Part XII was excluded.
rules.s: Employment Act 1955 First Schedule para. 2 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

rules.v: Cannot change without the employer's consent
rules.vi: Tidak dapat pindah tanpa persetujuan majikan
rules.n: Each employer needs the Director General's prior approval to employ a foreign employee (Employment Act s. 60K), and must report when the worker leaves, absconding included (ss. 57A, 57B). A pass stops being valid once its conditions are breached (Immigration Act s. 55B(2)). The rule tying the Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) to one employer, and any transfer procedure, sit in the Immigration Regulations 1963 and…

rules.v: May join but faces legal limits, or residence status makes membership largely theoretical
rules.vi: Boleh bergabung tetapi dibatasi hukum, atau status tinggal membuat keanggotaan nyaris teoretis
rules.n: Non-citizens may join a union but may not be, or act as, members of a union executive (s. 28(1)(a)) or be employed by a union (s. 29(2)(a)). For live-in domestic workers, membership is also limited in practice. LOM lists a 12 Jan 2024 instrument for this Act that could not be opened.

rules.v: Fees charged to the worker are capped or regulated
rules.vi: Biaya bagi pekerja dibatasi atau diatur
rules.n: Agencies may charge a non-citizen employee no more than one month's basic wage as a placement fee, plus no other fees beyond the First Schedule. If the employer pays, nothing may be taken from the worker (s. 14B(3)). Licence B covers foreign domestic servants. Fees charged in sending states are outside the Act.
rules.s: Private Employment Agencies Act 1981 (Act 246); Malaysia–Indonesia MOU 2022 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3165320_BI/Act%20246%20(REPRINT%202018).pdf

rules.v: Enrolled in the national labor or health insurance schemes
rules.vi: Terdaftar dalam skema jaminan ketenagakerjaan atau kesehatan nasional
rules.n: The First Schedule exclusion of domestic servants (para (3)) was deleted from 1 Jun 2021, which brings them within SOCSO. The deleted wording was checked in the 2016 Malay text. Only foreign workers without a valid pass are excluded (para (12A)). Which benefits apply to foreign domestic workers was not confirmed from an official text (for example, employment injury only).
rules.s: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 (Act 4); PERKESO announcement, 2021 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputp/1702260/PUA%20247.pdf

rules.v: Only general channels, or channels hard to reach from the workplace (for example at sea)
rules.vi: Hanya saluran umum, atau saluran yang sulit dijangkau dari tempat kerja (misalnya di laut)
rules.n: General channels only; the worker lives in the employer's home.

rules.n: No route was found in the texts read. Permanent residence (Entry Permit, s. 10) is at the Director General's discretion, and the Act does not count time on a temporary employment pass. Stay limits and pass conditions sit in the Immigration Regulations 1963 and Immigration Department policy, which could not be read on the trusted sites.

rules.n: Reported to be barred: Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) holders may not bring dependants, and pass conditions reportedly bar marriage in Malaysia and pregnancy. None of this appears in any text found on LOM, since the principal Immigration Regulations 1963 are not online there.

decisions.nm: Fice Fransina Nenobais v. Lee Hee Chooi
decisions.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker in Malaysia went unpaid for almost five years. The labour office refused her claim because she had no valid permit. The courts said she could still claim her wages.
decisions.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia di Malaysia tidak digaji hampir lima tahun. Kantor ketenagakerjaan menolak tuntutannya karena ia tidak punya izin yang sah. Pengadilan menyatakan ia tetap boleh menuntut upahnya.

decisions.nm: Public Prosecutor v. Ambika M.A. Shan (death of Adelina Lisao)
decisions.pe: Adelina, a young Indonesian domestic worker, died in Malaysia after being made to sleep outside with a dog and left with untreated wounds. The employer was freed when the prosecution dropped the case, causing protests in both countries.
decisions.pi: Adelina, pekerja rumah tangga muda Indonesia, meninggal di Malaysia setelah dipaksa tidur di luar bersama anjing dan lukanya tidak dirawat. Majikan dibebaskan saat jaksa mencabut perkara, memicu protes di kedua negara.

decisions.nm: Public Prosecutor v. Yim Pek Ha (Nirmala Bonat case)
decisions.pe: Nirmala, a domestic worker from Indonesia, was burned with an iron and scalded by her employer in Kuala Lumpur. The court convicted the employer and sent her to prison.
decisions.pi: Nirmala, pekerja rumah tangga dari Indonesia, disetrika dan disiram air panas oleh majikannya di Kuala Lumpur. Pengadilan memvonis majikan dan memenjarakannya.

decisions.nm: 93 migrant workers left without jobs on arrival
decisions.pe: Ninety-three workers arrived in Malaysia in 2023 and found there were no jobs for them. The Labour Court ordered the employer to pay them, and the High Court agreed.
decisions.pi: Sembilan puluh tiga pekerja tiba di Malaysia pada 2023 dan ternyata tidak ada pekerjaan untuk mereka. Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan memerintahkan majikan membayar, dan Pengadilan Tinggi setuju.

help.de: Helps migrant workers, domestic workers and trafficking survivors with complaints, shelter and legal referral.
help.di: Membantu pekerja migran, pekerja rumah tangga dan korban perdagangan orang dengan pengaduan, tempat tinggal sementara dan rujukan hukum.
